description: Literal clip names and original filenames seed labels without altering playback bindings. Naming overrides pin path, exact clip name and source_sha256; optional title/start_state/end_state/transition_steps/naming_evidence describe reviewed motion. naming_status is source_name, needs_review or verified; verified requires recorded evidence. A changed fingerprint invalidates curated names/classification. Unnamed/duplicate clip identities also require the parent preview fingerprint and exact index.
